pages.title: Macrophage
pages.text: $(thing)Macrophage$(): The big eater: a slow cell that engulfs whatever it catches and digests it. Caught, you are held inside and dissolved until you strike your way out; items and red cells it simply eats (and gives the items back when it dies). It goes for the Tumour Hydra too, as macrophages go for a real tumour. Found in Inner Space's Tissue and Bloodstream.$(br2)$(thing)Drops$(): Matrix Fibre, Lipid Bilayer.
